SELECT p.place_id, p.name, p.place_type, p.industry_category, p.management_company, p.address, p.grid_id, p.risk_level, p.main_risk_sources, p.longitude, p.latitude, p.coordinate_system, p.location_status, p.matched_address FROM fire_place p WHERE p.del_flag = '0' AND p.status = '0'
AND p.place_type IN ('industry', 'highrise', 'commercial', 'elderly') AND p.coordinate_system = 'GCJ02' AND p.longitude IS NOT NULL AND p.latitude IS NOT NULL AND p.longitude BETWEEN -180 AND 180 AND p.latitude BETWEEN -90 AND 90 AND NOT (p.longitude = 0 AND p.latitude = 0)
AND p.place_id = #{placeId} AND p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
AND p.place_type = #{placeType}
${params.dataScope} ORDER BY p.place_type, p.place_id LIMIT 5001

SELECT CAST(c.contact_id AS CHAR) AS contactId, c.contact_name AS contactName, c.phone, c.contact_role AS contactRole FROM fire_place_contact c JOIN fire_place p ON p.place_id = c.place_id WHERE p.place_id = #{placeId} AND p.del_flag = '0' AND p.status = '0' AND c.del_flag = '0' AND c.status = '0' ${params.dataScope} ORDER BY c.sort_order, c.contact_id
